title: Proven Results Across Industries
description: See how leading companies transformed their database operations with KubeDB

case_studies.challenge: MongoDB Atlas costs equal to entire 20-node Kubernetes cluster on Hetzner Cloud
case_studies.solution: Migrated to self-managed MongoDB using KubeDB operator with Stash backup solution
case_studies.quote: We saved around 90% of our costs and improved performance by keeping traffic inside Kubernetes.
case_studies.author: Volodymyr Lysetskyy

case_studies.challenge: Legacy databases couldn't keep pace with 5G demands - manual provisioning, scaling, backups, and upgrades created bottlenecks
case_studies.solution: Production-grade DBaaS with KubeDB automating full database lifecycle on Kubernetes with zero-downtime operations
case_studies.quote: From manual legacy databases to fully automated, production-grade DBaaS with complete data sovereignty and enterprise resilience.
case_studies.author: Platform Team

case_studies.challenge: Need to launch a white-label DBaaS platform to serve 20,000+ business customers with extreme time-to-market pressure
case_studies.solution: Integrated KubeDB with SUSE Rancher-based Kubernetes service and ACE UI for self-service DBaaS
case_studies.quote: Launched fully-featured public DBaaS in just 1 month with complete automation and white-label self-service experience.
case_studies.author: Platform Team
